jobs.occupation: Graduate Management Traineeship Programme (GMT) - Belgium M/W/X
jobs.description:
#Talent 

 

Launch Your Career with AB InBev: Graduate Management Trainee Program 

 

What is it? 

 

Our Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) programme is a  

• 10 months program starting in August 2027 
• 3-4-month rotations within the program 
• As a junior talent, you will work on real business projects situated in Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics 
• You will have a 70-20-10 learning and development approach, where 70% Learning on the Job, 20% Exposure to Other, 10% Formal Learning & Training 
Who are we looking for? 

 

You are willing to become a future leader within AB InBev, and should be comfortable with an ambiguous career track, and expect geographic mobility. The following qualities describe you: Leader. Proud Owner. Agile Learner. Collaborator. Future Maker. 

 To be eligible: 

• You must have graduated (before September 2027 and no more than two years prior) with a Bachelor's, Master's (or equivalent) degree. 
• You should also have no more than 2 years of professional experience (internships/volunteers/student jobs not included). 
• Your passion and ownership are more important than the subject you studied. 
• Fluent English is needed, as well as the native language of the country you are applying in. 
• A valid permanent visa/work permit is required in the country of application to be eligible for the programme. 
• During the 10-month program and beyond, you might be required to travel within your country of application and across Europe. 
 

We are looking for: Junior talent. Recent Graduate. Junior Manager. Professional Trainee. Graduate Trainee. 

 

How can you apply? 

 

• Before you apply, check more information https://europecareers.ab-inbev.com/programmes/graduate-management-traineeship  
• Please be advised that you will only be considered for the first application you submit, therefore please make sure you are completely happy with your choice as this decision is final. 
• There is no need to upload a cover letter - this will not affect your application. 
 

Good to know 

 

• Our Graduate Management Trainee Programme is the first step to an amazing career at AB InBev. 
• Post-Programme, you will pursue a rewarding career, often within our core functions at the heart of our business within Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics. 
• GMT programme will give you valuable exposure and insights into leading and transforming a successful global business. You will work on real projects with senior stakeholders to drive value and undertake a structured program to support your development as a future leader. 
 

What do we offer? 

 

Next to a competitive base salary, we put our people first by providing additional benefits: 

• Learning & Development opportunities  
• Quarterly vouchers to taste our delicious beers 
• Legal holidays + Compensation & additional days (40 Days in total for fulltime employment) 
• A unique Parental leave 
• Multiple Physical & Mental Wellbeing support Initiatives 
• Meal vouchers, allowances, gift per company policy 
• Competitive Life insurance, disability & medical plan 
• A Flexible Rewards system - (smartphone, bike lease, Extra pension Plan, etc.) 
 

Where?   

The GMT programme is available in:  ¿    Belgium ¿    France ¿    Germany ¿    Italy ¿    Netherlands ¿    United Kingdom

jobs.occupation: Project Manager IT – B2B Software Integration
jobs.description:
Lead the implementation of software solutions at external clients, across functional scoping, run and upgrade projects.

Project Manager IT | B2B Software Integration | Brussels

Our client is a Belgian company specialised in integrating and implementing software solutions at its clients’ sites, recognised for its strong presence among demanding organisations.

What makes it stand out? A portfolio of strategic accounts backed by a framework contract recently renewed for six years, giving it rare visibility over its projects and its teams.

Its activity combines run, ticketing and upgrade projects on heavily customised application platforms, deployed and maintained at the client’s site.

As it grows, the company is strengthening its delivery management team and is looking for a senior Project Manager IT with a background in software integration.

The job

• Reporting to the practice lead, you take operational ownership of several client accounts and the implementation projects attached to them.
• You manage the relationship between the client, the internal teams and an external technical partner, while keeping a firm grip on the functional content of the projects.Role
• Manage the budgets, deadlines and contractual commitments of your accounts.
• Work with the business analyst on scoping client needs: challenge requests, measure them against the platform’s capabilities and decide which customisations to retain.
• Steer the external partner delivering the technical teams, and coordinate exchanges between client, partner and internal teams.
• Follow up on run and ticketing, and lead upgrade and evolution projects.
• Identify contractual, budgetary and operational risks, and bring the trade-offs to the client.
Profile
• Senior experience on the vendor side — with an integrator, a software vendor or a consultancy — implementing software solutions at external clients.
• Comfortable with the functional side of projects: you understand the solutions you deploy and can challenge an analysis or a specification rather than only coordinate. A background in functional analysis is an asset.
• Fluent English is essential; administrative rigour, diplomacy and political judgement when dealing with demanding clients.

At Telenet Business, our business customers always come first. With our strong portfolio of connectivity and ICT solutions, we help companies, organizations and government institutions collaborate seamlessly, stay secure and perform at their best in the digital world.

 
As a Business Consultant within B2B Delivery & Services Excellence, you help transform our order-to-cash and customer service management processes, ensuring our employees have the right tools and processes to support customers effectively. You connect business teams with strategic and transformational programs, technology teams, product owners, external partners and business analysts.

 
Ready to come and do your thing with us?

Your role as Transformation Business Consultant

 
• Drive successful transformation by representing the business in major programs and connecting business teams with technology teams, product owners, analysts and external partners.
 
• Represent the business in strategic and transformational programs across order-to-cash and customer service processes.
 
• Translate business strategy and operational needs into clear priorities, roadmaps and valuable outcomes.
 
• Align stakeholders across business, technology, architecture, product teams and external partners.
 
• Shape business cases, validate benefits and explore solutions that create measurable value.
 
• Ensure effective delivery and adoption by involving the right experts in analysis, testing and training.
 
• Report clearly on progress, risks, issues and outcomes to business owners and leadership.

Your profile as Transformation Business Consultant

 
• Brings experience in business transformation and quickly builds a strong understanding of processes, customers and operations.
 
• Combines analytical strength with a data-driven approach to priorities, decisions and value creation.
 
• Has excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including with leadership.
 
• Works autonomously, connects the dots and remains effective in complex and ambiguous environments.
 
• Has sufficient digital and technical affinity to collaborate with technology teams and partners; knowledge of telecom, ICT, agile, ITIL or PRINCE2 is an advantage.
 
• Is fluent in written and spoken Dutch and English.

Our offer to you
At Telenet group, you get more than just an attractive gross salary. We strongly believe in results and ownership: we expect commitment and impact, and we’ll give you the trust and freedom you need to make a difference. What you achieve truly matters.

In addition to a thirteenth-month salary and holiday pay, you can count on an extensive package of extra benefits that supports you in your daily life as well as at work.

An overview of our benefits:

 
• Mobility budget: compose your own mobility plan, you can opt for a company car or alternative mobility solutions
 
• Meal vouchers and eco vouchers
 
• Telework allowance or net expense allowance
 
• Mobile phone, mobile subscription and laptop
 
• Employee discount on your home internet, digital TV, and mobile subscriptions
 
• Collective bonus and individual bonus (aligned with your performance)
 
• A comprehensive flexible benefits plan with a wide range of options: from financial benefits and additional time off to a bicycle lease, supplemental ambulatory insurance for you and your family, and IT or office equipment

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant - International and Dynamic Environment
jobs.description:
Company Presentation

We are recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing company operating in the service sector linked to healthcare, located in the Brussels region.

This human-sized structure operates in a dynamic and modern environment, where innovation and service quality play a central role. The team, made up of around ten employees, works in a professional yet friendly atmosphere, with an accessible management style focused on collaboration.

The company stands out for its financial stability, continuous growth, and a corporate culture built on trust, autonomy, and teamwork. Internal initiatives and strong cohesion between departments contribute to a pleasant and motivating working environment.

Missions / Responsibilities

• Oversee the full accounting scope, both general and analytical, across multiple entities, ensuring accuracy and compliance of financial data.
• Record and follow up on day-to-day transactions (purchase and sales invoices, financial operations, and various accounting entries).
• Prepare and submit VAT returns, ensuring full compliance with Belgian tax regulations.
• Actively participate in monthly and annual closings, including period-end entries and cut-off operations.
• Perform bank reconciliations and ensure proper monitoring of customer and supplier balances.
• Carry out account reconciliations and ensure consistency of accounting records.
• Contribute to financial reporting and the preparation of dashboards for management.
• Participate in the continuous improvement and optimisation of accounting processes and internal tools.
• Collaborate with internal teams and, when necessary, with external partners (accounting firms, auditors, etc.).

Profile Required

• Education Degree in accounting, finance, or equivalent through experience.
• Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in general accounting, ideally in a multi-entity or international environment.
• Technical skills Strong command of accounting tools and Excel. Good knowledge of accounting closings and Belgian tax obligations. ERP knowledge is an asset.
• Languages Fluent in French and strong professional level of English, both written and spoken.
• Personal qualities Rigorous, autonomous, analytical mindset, and strong team spirit. You are also proactive and solution-oriented.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.Coordination She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.

• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.
